name: Employer-Sponsored Work Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Ley de Migracion y Extranjeria (Decreto 208-2003), Article 40: the General Migration Directorate (now INM) verifies the 'conditions of contracting' in consultation with the Ministry of Labor before granting a special residence permit tied to the job. Article 41 covers professionals and educators specifically, requiring compliance with the licensing requirements to practice that profession in Honduras. Permits run up to 5 years per Article 39.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a Honduran employment contract, have it verified by INM in consultation with the Labor Ministry, and (for regulated professions) hold the required Honduran professional license.

sources.title: Instituto Nacional de Migracion de Honduras -- hosted primary legal text of Decreto 208-2003, Ley de Migracion y Extranjeria, Articles 39-41 (contracted-worker and professional residence permits) and Article 39(12) (family members of contracted workers)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Honduras). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- hard requirement sourced directly to the government-hosted primary statutory text (Honduras's own migration authority hosting its own law), tier 1. family_can_join set true per Article 39(12), which extends permits to family members of contracted workers. leads_to_pr set false: the law caps this permit at 5 years but does not itself state a conversion path to permanent ('Inmigrado') status -- see hn_investor_residence.json and hn_citizenship_naturalisation.json for Honduras's separate permanent-residence and naturalization tracks, which likely apply after continuous residence but were not explicitly cross-confirmed as automatic from this specific permit. work_rights set 'restricted' since the permit is tied to the verified contract/profession, not open work authorization.
